radiusSource: Radius 1.1 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since HD 118203 c does not transit, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html): 78,641.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 11.79 Jupiter masses (Zhang et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024AJ....168..295Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
orbitalPeriodSource: Zhang et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..295Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ZHANG_ET_AL__2024): P 5103 d

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, colour, map or oblateness of HD 118203 c is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.

massSource: 11.79 Jupiter masses: Zhang et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024AJ....168..295Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..295Z/abstract).
